stem: How did the American colonists IMMEDIATELY respond to the 1774 laws described in these headlines?

options.label: F
options.text: The First Continental Congress declared war on Great Britain.

options.label: G
options.text: The colonists adopted the Articles of Confederation.

options.label: H
options.text: The First Continental Congress sent a list of grievances to King George III.

options.label: J
options.text: The colonists adopted the Bill of Rights.

visual_elements: Four newspapers with headline text: 1) Great Britain Orders Closure of Boston Harbor Until Money Lost from Tea Is Repaid 2) Great Britain Dissolves Massachusetts Legislature 3) Great Britain Allows British Officials in America Charged with Crimes to Go to England for Trial 4) Great Britain Authorizes Colonial Governors to Quarter British Soldiers in Unoccupied Buildings
